debug.description: Ordinary debug compatibility tests with controller-only, physical and minified-release contracts excluded explicitly.

excludedGates.reason: Requires an authorized physical ARM64 project, selected camera and Agent086 capture protocol.
Requires Agent088 external kill/relaunch controller, a fresh nonce and stage/phase arguments.
Requires an authorized disposable workload project and Agent087 physical resource protocol.
Requires Agent089 external controller to verify disabled radios before supplying offlinePrivacy=true.
Requires the non-debuggable minified release app and matching release test APK; use release scope.
Requires the Agent099 dedicated controller to verify candidate source/APK/installed-package and physical-bundle identities and its separate rf099_evidence metadata sequence.
Requires tools/android-ui-e2e/run.py --scenario physical_capture with an authorized physical scene, operator receipt, verified non-emulator identity and host CAMERA reset.
Requires tools/android-ui-e2e/run.py --scenario permission_denial_regrant to revoke CAMERA and clear permission flags before starting a dedicated instrumentation process.

release.description: Ordinary release compatibility tests plus the required minified-release native contract; specialist controllers remain separate.

excludedGates.reason: Requires an authorized physical ARM64 project, selected camera and Agent086 capture protocol.

Requires the Agent099 dedicated controller to verify candidate source/APK/installed-package and physical-bundle identities and its separate rf099_evidence metadata sequence.
Requires tools/android-ui-e2e/run.py --scenario physical_capture with an authorized physical scene, operator receipt, verified non-emulator identity and host CAMERA reset.
